name: loka-wikidata-v14
notes: Top rung of the normalized-wikidata series and the best model overall. Trained on the v14-1M corpus (4,021,409 clean labeled triples, ~12x v11's size). Same 44.5M-parameter BPE architecture. Per-epoch trajectory (5-epoch partial-local run): ep1 283.07, ep2 215.45, ep3 209.55, ep4 202.01 (best), ep5 204.70. Pinned at the epoch-4 checkpoint, ppl 202.01 — the lowest in the entire v11-v14 series and a clear demonstration that corpus scale was the binding lever (v11 350k -> 279.12, v12 672k -> 250.82, v13 2.5M -> 242.75, v14 4M -> 202.01). Unlike v13 (which plateaued by epoch 2), v14 was still descending at epoch 4 on the larger corpus. A 6-10 epoch continuation was attempted but OOM'd when an unrelated pytest run grabbed the 8GB laptop GPU; rather than re-run, we ship epoch 4 since it is already the series best and the full clean 10-epoch run is available via the donor path (tools/contribute_v14_training.py). Per-epoch tags v14.1 through v14.5 on HF via the snapshot pusher. Companion dataset: EmmaLeonhart/normalized-wikidata tag v14-1M.
